title: DX: CLAUDE.md "Running tests" omits the required pnpm build step
description: CLAUDE.md + README.md "Running tests"/"Tests" sections omitted the prerequisite workspace build. Each @flash/* package resolves its "." export to ./dist/index.js, so on a fresh checkout cross-package @flash/* imports fail in tests until dist/ exists. FIX (docs-only): added "pnpm --filter './packages/**' build" before the unit-test commands in both CLAUDE.md and README.md. VERIFIED in a fresh worktree (no node_modules/dist): repro showed 95 swf suites fail with "Failed to resolve entry for package @flash/core"; after the documented build step, swf suite = 108 test files passed, 1358 tests passed (0 resolve errors). Out of scope: task 1207 missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla.
